issue.title: Recipes - Delete Recipe
issue.description:
## 💡 User Story
As a contributor,
I want to delete a recipe,
so that other users don't try to make it.

## 📋Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Only the recipe owner with the delete:recipes permission or an admin can delete a recipe
- [ ] A delete option is visible on the "My Recipes" page and on indiviual recipe page
- [ ] Before deletion, the user is shown a confirmation dialog to confirm the deletion
- [ ] After confirmation, the recipe and its associated nutritional details table are permanently deleted
- [ ] After deletion the user remains on or is redirected to the "My Recipes" page (depending where they performed the delete action)

## 🔍 Tech Analysis
### Backend
- Create a DELETE recipes/:id
- Verifiy that the requesting user has delete:recipes and ownership of the recipe
- Remove all entries from the DB relating to the deleted recipe

### Frontend
- Delete button is conditionally rendered based on user.id === recipe.owner_id or user.role === admin
- On success, the recipe is removed the user is redirected and a success dialog is shown
- On failed deletion, an error/notification is shown to the user
